question: In a certain code language, 'ROMKSG' is written as 'SQPJQD', and 'PNDABC' is written as 'QPGZZZ'. How will 'QJLMTF' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'ROMKSG' is written as 'SQPJQD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a34391a8416ea5c4ca0966c2bd6042f3d7dc3c00544c7d0e842076f48db0ff51.png] 

For, 'PNDABC' is written as 'QPGZZZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c09b770952fec00c926c3b5baa5341afa14634c4adb66551134dc7fe3e006548.png] 

Similarly, for QJLMTF:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5d8e31f178093a10cb905ea71cd32901290ca2095bfc09a93fe112f62c29412.png] 

So, 'QJLMTF' will be coded as 'RLOLRC'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
